```{=html}
<section class="home-hero column-screen">
  <div class="home-hero-inner">
    <div>
      <p class="affil">Australian National University</p>
      <h1>Analytics for the Australian Grains Industry</h1>
      <p class="lede">Statistical methods and research software for field trials, plant phenomics and the grains research community.</p>
      <div class="hero-actions">
        <a class="primary" href="/people/">Meet the team</a>
        <a href="/software/">Browse our software</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <figure class="trial-figure">
      <svg id="trial-grid" role="img" aria-label="A field trial of 240 plots in four blocks, shaded by a simulated spatial yield trend"></svg>
    </figure>
  </div>
</section>

<script>
(() => {
  const svg = document.getElementById("trial-grid");
  if (!svg) return;
  const rows = 10, cols = 24, block = 6;
  const w = 18, h = 30, gap = 3, blockGap = 10;
  const stops = [[36, 80, 59], [126, 143, 62], [230, 203, 133], [190, 131, 14]];
  let seed = 8677;
  const rand = () => (seed = (seed * 16807) % 2147483647) / 2147483647;
  const colour = (t) => {
    t = Math.min(0.999, Math.max(0, t)) * (stops.length - 1);
    const i = Math.floor(t), f = t - i, a = stops[i], b = stops[i + 1];
    return `rgb(${a.map((v, k) => Math.round(v + (b[k] - v) * f)).join(",")})`;
  };
  const width = cols * (w + gap) - gap + (cols / block - 1) * blockGap;
  const height = rows * (h + gap) - gap;
  svg.setAttribute("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`);
  const ns = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
    for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
      const trend = 0.5 + 0.28 * Math.sin(c / 4.2) * Math.cos(r / 3.5)
        + 0.18 * Math.cos((c + r) / 6) - 0.35 * Math.exp(-((c - 17) ** 2 + (r - 2) ** 2) / 12);
      const noise = (rand() + rand() + rand() - 1.5) * 0.18;
      const rect = document.createElementNS(ns, "rect");
      rect.setAttribute("x", c * (w + gap) + Math.floor(c / block) * blockGap);
      rect.setAttribute("y", r * (h + gap));
      rect.setAttribute("width", w);
      rect.setAttribute("height", h);
      rect.setAttribute("rx", 1.5);
      rect.setAttribute("fill", colour(trend + noise));
      rect.style.animationDelay = `${c * 35 + r * 12}ms`;
      svg.appendChild(rect);
    }
  }
})();
</script>
```
